clue.text: Young knight and composer part after a setback

parts.note: J S Bach is the composer

indicators.note: a setback turns the word for part back to front, and it comes after the composer

parts.note: a part in a play is a role

explanation.surface: A young knight and a composer play a role after suffering a reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after a setback' turns the role backwards and puts it after the composer. 'Young knight' is fair: a bachelor was historically a novice knight serving under another's banner.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically a bachelor was a novice knight, one too young or poor to lead his own retainers.

clue.text: Strip to the waist maybe, like some riders

explanation.surface: Getting undressed above the belt, as horse riders sometimes do.
explanation.definitionFit: Stripping to the waist leaves the torso uncovered, and some riders go without a saddle on the horse.

clue.text: Senior priest's set of rules

explanation.surface: A senior cleric's book of regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathedral clergyman of rank holds this title, and the same word means a body of laws or principles, as in church law.

clue.text: Unpredictable criteria somehow putting one off

indicators.note: somehow says the letters of criteria are rearranged in some fashion
putting off says a letter is removed from the jumble and discarded
putting off says a letter is removed from the jumble and discarded

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Unreliable criteria that somehow deter one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' rearranges CRITERIA, and 'putting ... off' takes out the I (one), so the seven letters left make the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something erratic behaves irregularly, so you cannot forecast what it will do.

clue.text: Duty we'll pay for

explanation.surface: A tax or charge that a group offers to cover.
explanation.definitionFit: An obligation or burden is a duty; read as two words, 'it's on us' is what hosts say when they will pay the bill.

clue.text: Coaches for various levels?

explanation.surface: Coaches arranged for groups at different levels.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagecoaches were called stages, and the word also means steps or phases in a process.

clue.text: Learn from me - - drink's dear in Paris

parts.note: tea is a drink
cher is French for dear

explanation.surface: An instruction to learn from the speaker, who notes that drink is expensive in Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: A schoolmaster or tutor is the person pupils learn from.

clue.text: American soldier captures a rude Italian leader

indicators.note: captures means the soldier's letters hold the rest inside them

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier
ribald means coarse or rude

explanation.surface: A US soldier seizes a coarse Italian commander.
explanation.walkthrough: Giuseppe Garibaldi led the unification of Italy in the 19th century.
explanation.definitionFit: Garibaldi was the military commander of the Risorgimento, the movement that unified Italy.

clue.text: Calm down sue losing heart to boyfriend?

indicators.note: losing heart means the middle letter of sue drops out, leaving its first and last letters

parts.note: a date can be a boyfriend one is seeing

explanation.surface: Someone advised to calm down rather than take a boyfriend to court.
explanation.definitionFit: To sedate someone is to tranquillise them with a drug.

clue.text: Manage to get a number of drinks into car

parts.note: to run a business is to manage it
a round is a set of drinks bought for a group

explanation.surface: Someone manages to get a round of drinks into their car.
explanation.walkthrough: A runaround is British slang for a small car used for local trips.
explanation.definitionFit: A small, cheap vehicle used for short local journeys is called this in British usage.

clue.text: Customer service offered by food shop exceptionally

parts.note: a deli, short for delicatessen, is a food shop
exceptionally, as in exceptionally good, means very

explanation.surface: A food shop that offers exceptional customer service.
explanation.definitionFit: Bringing goods to the buyer's door is a service a shop provides to its customers.

clue.text: Excellent left-winger given broadcast

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, with the 1 read as the letter I
a red is a socialist or communist

explanation.surface: A first-rate socialist gets a television slot.
explanation.definitionFit: A programme that has gone out on radio or television has been transmitted.

clue.text: Fish with nasty smell? Then there's refusal to eat it

parts.note: BO is body odour

indicators.note: to eat means the refusal takes the next word inside, as if swallowing it

parts.note: no is a refusal

explanation.surface: A diner says no to a smelly fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonito is a small tuna-like fish of the mackerel family.

clue.text: A record made by hospital to help a series of characters

parts.note: an LP is a long-playing record
to abet is to help, usually in wrongdoing

explanation.surface: A hospital produces a record to support a television drama series.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters A to Z form an ordered set of written symbols.

clue.text: Lie in bed after munching? Hospital food mustn't be that bad!

definitions.text: Hospital food mustn't be that bad!

indicators.note: munching breaks up the words lie in bed, as chewing breaks up food

explanation.surface: A patient lying in bed eating hospital food that had better not be awful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after munching' rearranges the letters of LIE IN BED; the definition is a whole cryptic sentence describing food too bad to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Food so bad it cannot be eaten is unfit for consumption.

clue.text: A cavern, a place that's wild somewhere by the Atlantic

indicators.note: wild says the letters of a cavern and a place run untamed into a new order

explanation.surface: A cave and a place that are untamed, on the Atlantic coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wild' rearranges A CAVERN A PLACE. The answer is the Florida headland from which American spacecraft are launched.
explanation.definitionFit: This Florida promontory, home of the Kennedy Space Center, lies on the Atlantic coast.

clue.text: Bird to proceed over Ireland and England initially

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the first piece sits above the next

parts.note: to pass is to go on or proceed
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of England

explanation.surface: A bird flies on over Ireland and England at the start of a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: Passerines are perching birds, the order that includes sparrows and finches.

clue.text: I get germ shifted - - it involves use of sand

indicators.note: shifted means the letters of I get germ are moved around

explanation.surface: A germ moved into me, involving sand somehow.
explanation.definitionFit: A small hourglass for boiling eggs works by running sand from one bulb to the other.

clue.text: Sarah attending to one of the items on a meal table

definitions.text: one of the items on a meal table

parts.note: Sal is a short form of the name Sarah
addressing a problem is attending to it

explanation.surface: Sarah waiting on someone with one of the items on the dining table.
explanation.definitionFit: A vinaigrette or similar sauce for leaves is a condiment set out at mealtimes.

clue.text: Drag fish up away from the wind

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the pieces are read from the bottom upwards, backwards

parts.note: to draw is to drag or pull
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: Hauling a fish out of the water away from the wind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns DRAWEEL backwards. The leeward side is the sheltered side, facing away from the wind.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship the sheltered side, downwind, is the lee side.

clue.text: Disaster gets prison warder out of bed

parts.note: screw is slang for a prison officer
up means risen from bed

explanation.surface: Trouble when a prison officer gets up.
explanation.walkthrough: SCREW is British slang for a prison officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A blunder or mess that ruins things is a fiasco.

clue.text: Says street should have repaired seat

indicators.note: repaired means the letters of seat are fixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone declares the street should have its benches mended.
explanation.definitionFit: To state something is to declare or assert it.

clue.text: They bred specially for a big race

indicators.note: specially means the letters of they bred are made into a special arrangement

explanation.surface: Horses bred specifically for a major race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'specially' rearranges THEY BRED. The Derby is the famous English flat horse race run at Epsom.
explanation.definitionFit: The Derby at Epsom is one of the most prestigious flat horse races in Britain.

clue.text: Run into conflict, creating panic

indicators.note: into means the abbreviation for run goes inside the word for conflict

parts.note: a fight is a conflict
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Running into a battle causes alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden scare brings sudden terror or alarm.

clue.text: Bunch to become mature without women

indicators.note: without means the abbreviation for women is removed

parts.note: to grow up is to become mature

explanation.surface: A gang that must mature without any women around.
explanation.definitionFit: A cluster or collection of things or people together.

clue.text: Competent-sounding fellow killed by brother

indicators.note: sounding means the word for competent is said aloud, giving a name that sounds the same

parts.note: able means competent

explanation.surface: A capable-seeming man murdered by his sibling.
explanation.walkthrough: In Genesis, Abel was killed by his brother Cain.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, Adam and Eve's son was murdered by Cain, his elder sibling.

clue.text: That is gear regularly abandoned in forest

indicators.note: regularly abandoned means every other letter of that is gear is dropped, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: Equipment periodically left behind in woodland.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking the odd letters of THAT IS GEAR gives the answer, the coniferous forest of the subarctic north.
explanation.definitionFit: The taiga is the vast belt of coniferous woodland across Siberia and northern Canada.

clue.text: Necessity for one sort of joint accommodating another

definitions.text: Necessity for one sort of joint accommodating another

parts.words: Necessity for one sort of joint accommodating another
parts.note: a bodily joint needs space to move, and the clue plays on the word joint, a hinge of the arm needing space to work

explanation.surface: Something a joint requires to fit inside another.
explanation.definitionFit: Space enough to move freely is what the arm's hinge needs when jostled in a crowd.

clue.text: Good person - - in seventh 'eaven or serious?

parts.note: St, saint, is a good person
in seventh heaven means elated or heady, and the dropped h of the Cockney spelling drops the h of the synonym too

explanation.surface: Asking whether a saint is blissfully happy or solemn.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in ''eaven' mimics Cockney speech, which drops the H, so the synonym HEADY is dropped to 'EADY.
explanation.definitionFit: A steady, sober person is reliable and earnest rather than frivolous.

clue.text: Killer of small creatures that could make prey flap

indicators.note: could make says the letters of prey flap can be rearranged to form the answer

explanation.surface: Something that kills insects by making prey flutter.
explanation.definitionFit: Sticky paper hung up to trap insects kills house flies and other pests.
